info.title: CNC Twin API
info.description:
HTTP API of CNC Twin, the one-to-one CNC machining simulator: projects, simulation runs (queued as
jobs, followed with Server-Sent Events, cancelled and resumed from checkpoints), everything a run
writes (findings and their causes, time series downsampled with M4, the scene, frames, keyframes,
chips, coolant jets, inspection, surface, tools, production, files with range requests), studies
(compare, uncertainty, calibration, parameter sweeps with their training data) and the databases. A run the run
cache holds is answered instead of simulated again. SI units throughout (names carry units).
See docs/api.md.

get.description: Version, data folder, job counts and limits, and which optional parts this build has.
Jobs, newest first.
SSE: ``progress`` whenever the job record changes, then ``done``.
What the job wrote into its output folder.
The job process's standard output and error (range requests work: tail with bytes=-4096).

Compare two finished runs (cnctwin.report.compare, as a job). The result is kept: asking
again for the same pair (unchanged run.json files) returns it at once.

post.description:
Start an uncertainty study around a run (cnctwin.uncertainty, as a job; the project's
``uncertainty:`` section with ``options`` on top).
Calibrate the machine model from recorded machine data (cnctwin.mdata.calibrate, as a job).

get.description: Every project: the examples (always listed, read-only), then the uploads.

post.description: Upload a zipped project folder (project.yaml at its top, or in its one top folder).

requestBody.description: The project as a zip: the archive itself, or multipart/form-data with the archive in a field named 'file'

get.description: project.yaml (as written), its operations and its files.
A file of the project (programs, CAD, meshes), with HTTP range requests.

post.description:
Run the project check (``twin check``) as a job: 200 with its result when it finishes
within wait_s, else 202 with the job to poll.

parameters.name: wait_s

schema.description: wait this long for the result
schema.title: Wait S

parameters.description: wait this long for the result

post.description:
Queue a simulation of a project; follow it with GET /api/runs/{id}/events. When the run cache holds a
finished run of the same project, inputs, options and build (and ``no_cache`` is not set), that run is
answered (200, ``cache.hit``) instead; a new run is registered in the cache when it has finished.

200.description: The run cache holds this run: it is answered instead of a new simulation

get.description: Runs, newest first (status, verdict and summary of each).
run.json (null until finished) and status.json, with the latest job and checkpoint.
SSE: ``progress`` (status.json changed), ``finding``, ``keyframe``, then ``done``.

post.description: Stop a queued or running simulation (it stops at its next progress callback).

Continue a cancelled or failed simulation from its last committed checkpoint
(from the start when it has none).

get.description: A trace event and its chain of causes (ancestors, breadth first).
channels.json: every recorded channel with unit, tier, owner, doc, max_shape and dtype.

Channel values over time; above max_points rows, M4 keeps each bucket's first, last,
minimum and maximum sample (peaks are never smoothed away).
Full-resolution series of one tier as CSV (streamed; NaN as empty) or one Parquet file.
The program of an operation (by name, or index) as it was run.
timeline.json: the executed blocks with their tick ranges (filtered by op and time).
scene.json: machine components, chain, axes, fixture, stock, tools, nozzles, frames header.
frames.bin records between t0 and t1 (raw bytes, or column-wise JSON).

parameters.name: max_frames

schema.description: every n-th frame to stay below this
schema.title: Max Frames

parameters.description: every n-th frame to stay below this

200.description: records as in scene.json frames header

get.description: The changed in-process-workpiece bricks of keyframe k (full snapshot every 20 keyframes).

Coarse fields of keyframe k: surface temperatures, chip piles, wetted cells, tool deflection,
part pose, coolant jets (kf_<k>.npz).

One brick of the in-process workpiece as it was at time t: one ranged read of the
keyframe file named by keyframes/bricks.idx (the latest entry at or before t).

200.description: the brick's record in its keyframe file

get.description: Chips in flight and the pile summary at the keyframe at or before t (chips/kf_<k>.npz).
Coolant jets (in M) at the keyframe at or before t, and the nozzles of the scene.
Tools with a stability lobe diagram.
Stability lobe diagram of a tool (sld/<tool>.json; a bare number n also finds T<n>).
Measured tolerances (inspection.json)
Surface finish and burrs (surface.json)
Tool wear and life (tools.json)
Cycle time, cost and energy (production.json)
Any file of the run (video.mp4, report.pdf, part_<op>.glb ...), with HTTP range requests.

post.description:
Start a parameter sweep of a project (cnctwin.sweep, as a job): the spec's points run one after
another through the run cache (cached points are not simulated again), then the dataset is exported.

get.description: Sweeps, newest first.
The sweep's job, progress, summary and every point (values, status, run, verdict).
The database kinds and how many items each has.
Items of one kind (``machines`` or ``machine``, ``tools`` ...; ``bibliography``).
One item as written, its SI view and problems, and the bibliography entries it cites.
A document of the build's docs/ folder (``approximations.md``, ``models/loop.md`` ...) as Markdown text.
